### Highlights | 更新内容

- 手柄的 Menu 键现在可以完整交还给游戏。此前长按超过一秒再松开会切换鼠标模式并伴随震动，需要这个长按手势的游戏没有关闭入口（issue #45）。新增每台主机的独立开关，默认保持原有行为，改动在下一次长按立即生效，无需重连。
  The controller's Menu button can now be handed back to the game. Holding it past a second and releasing has switched mouse mode with a rumble for as long as this fork existed, so games that need that hold had no way to keep the button (issue #45). A per-host switch now controls it, defaulting to the previous behaviour, and it is read per press so the change lands on the next hold rather than the next connection.
- 习惯用 Control 复制粘贴的用户可以保留肌肉记忆。新增每台主机的 `Command Key Sends Control` 开关，默认关闭；开启后所有 Command 组合键会以 Control 抵达主机。它不是恢复旧的多套映射：全局仍只有一张映射表，开关只改写该答案内部的两个 Windows 键位，因此不会出现 Control 与 Win 同时发出。
  Players whose Copy and Paste habit is a Control habit can keep it. A new per-host `Command Key Sends Control` switch is off by default; turning it on makes every Command chord arrive on the host as Control. It is not a return of the old mode list: one mapping table still answers, and the switch only relabels the two Windows bits inside that answer, so a Command press never sends Control and Win together.
- 安全注意序列（Ctrl+Alt+Del）有了现成的按钮。macOS 不会像 Windows 那样拦截这个组合，因此普通翻译规则即可送达，缺的只是玩家不会想到要手写一条。设置 → 输入 → 快捷键规则 新增 `Add Preset`，一键预填该规则，触发与输出取自同一个和弦，不会两边漂移。
  The secure attention sequence now has a button. macOS does not intercept Ctrl+Alt+Del the way Windows does, so an ordinary translation rule reaches the host; the only thing missing was that no player would think to write one. `Settings → Input → Shortcut Rules` gained an `Add Preset` menu whose one entry prefills that rule, with the trigger and the output built from the same chord so they cannot drift apart.

### Fixed | 修复

- 键盘设置里那个只有一个选项的菜单不再是菜单。键盘兼容模式在旧模式移除后只剩一种，打开菜单只会看到当前值、什么也改不了；现在这一行直接把映射写出来，下方的 Command 开关才是玩家真正能决定的东西。
  The keyboard settings menu with a single item is no longer a menu. After the legacy modes were removed only one mapping remains, so opening it showed the value already in force and changed nothing. The row now states the mapping directly, and the Command switch beneath it is the one thing on that panel a player can decide.
- 手柄 Menu 长按不再有两套计时器。两个手柄输入路径各自维护一份长按起始时间，同一个边界对玩家意味着两件事；现在两条路径共用同一个判定与同一个开关。此前设计文档把这个手势记为“不存在”，因为只查了 `toggleMouseMode` 的键盘调用点，该记录已更正。
  The Menu long press no longer keeps two clocks. Each controller input path maintained its own start time for the hold, so one boundary meant two things to a player; both paths now share a single decision and a single switch. The design document had recorded this gesture as absent, because it only looked at the keyboard call site for `toggleMouseMode`; that row is corrected.

### Maintenance | 维护更新

- 新增 `docs/usb-redirection-host-contract.md`，把 USB 设备重定向中客户端无法单方面完成的那一半写成主机侧可以明确答复的契约：`/serverinfo` 需要回答的能力字段、会话消息，以及双方在声称“兼容”之前各自要拿出什么证据。文档同时说明这些符号在客户端与主机两侧都还不存在，在主机能被观察到应答之前，客户端不会接上一个无人消费的检测。
  A new `docs/usb-redirection-host-contract.md` states the half of USB device redirection a client cannot finish alone, as something a host repository can answer yes or no to: the capability field `/serverinfo` must carry, the session messages it is asking for, and what each side has to prove before either calls the pair compatible. It also says plainly that these symbols exist in neither tree, and that the client will not wire a capability check no one consumes until a host can be observed answering it.
- 本轮的判定项都由真实编译器与植入缺陷验证：映射与长按判定用 clang 编译后由样本驱动，安全注意序列在真实的 `sendSyntheticRemoteShortcut:` 线路上比对主机将收到的报文，断言电池 108/108，约束审计 0 失败。仍未验证的同样是事实：没有 Windows 桌面在环内，因此新开关与预设对真实主机与登录界面的效果尚未实测。
  Every claim this round is checked by a real compiler and by planted defects: the mapping and the long-press decision are compiled with clang and driven with samples, the secure attention preset is asserted against the packets a real `sendSyntheticRemoteShortcut:` call would put on the wire, and the assertion battery reports 108/108 with 0 constraint failures. What stays unverified is stated as a fact as well: with no Windows desktop in the loop, the effect of the new switch and preset on a real host and its login screen has not been observed.
